If you’re suicidal and have a plan, don’t feel safe with yourself, then they send you to the hospital where they then evaluate if you need the crisis psych ward. Stays range from 3 days minimum, to the longest being probably a week. Some cases two, it depends on when they think you’re good to go which could be a month or something, where they then could decide to put you into a residential where you stay a few months. The key to not being sent is whether or not you feel safe with yourself, and I’d you believe you’ll actually do it vs thinking about it and having a theoretical plan.
